content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Kalyani Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Kalyani Tutor (Non-Academic) posts?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. Candidates must attend the interview on 29th September 2026 with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Tutor (Non-Academic) post?
faq.answer: For medical candidates, an MBBS degree from a recognized university is required. For non-medical candidates, a Master's degree in the concerned specialty is necessary.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Tutor (Non-Academic) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years as of the notification date. Age relaxation is provided for PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Tutor (Non-Academic) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Tutor (Non-Academic) post at AIIMS Kalyani.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Tutor (Non-Academic) post?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs.15,600-39,100+GP 5,400 (6th CPC) or Level 10 of the Pay Matrix of the Seventh Pay Commission + NPA for Medical Graduates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for AIIMS Kalyani recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1000/- for Unreserved/OBC, Rs. 500/- for SC/ST/EWS, and exempted for PWBD candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves verification of application and requisite documents, followed by a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for AIIMS Kalyani recruitment being held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at AIIMS Kalyani. Candidates are advised to report at the venue as per the time mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: The Tutor (Non-Academic) posts are on a contract basis for a maximum period of 1 year.
